phase_0.boundary_condition: The Toxcatl cycle, the solar year boundary ensuring the renewal of the Mexica cosmos.

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest state of the Smoking Mirror before the choice of the impersonator.

TANCH.justification: The terminal anchor that terminates the ascent and secures the cosmic boundary.

AFWD.chosen_element: The year of living as God
AFWD.justification: The forward transformation of a youth into the living presence of the deity.

AREV.justification: The progressive surrender of divine attributes during the ascent of the pyramid stages.

CLINK.justification: The chaining of specific cultural actions—dressing, wedding, processing—into a singular path.

IMSCRIB.justification: The identity where the human becomes himself the divine image, a self-referential living sign.

FSPLIT.justification: The single divine essence branches into the stoichiometric representation of four specific goddesses.

FFUSE.justification: The goddesses are left behind, reconstituting the singular essence for the final ascent.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative willingness of the impersonator to complete the cycle.

EVALF.justification: A negative evaluation of the physical body or performance which would abort the ritual.

ENGAGR.justification: The state where the actor is simultaneously a mortal youth and the supreme god Tezcatlipoca.

IFIX.justification: The permanent, irreversible fixation of the sacrifice into the cosmic record.

phase_2.split_input: The manifest divine social presence of the ixiptla
phase_2.fuse_result: The singular divine essence prepared for sacrificial transition

phase_3.void_description: Pre-ritual selection; the youth is merely a captive among others.
phase_3.true_description: The god-impersonator as a perfected vessel, recognized by the community.
phase_3.false_description: The breaking of social protocol or injury to the ixiptla; ritual failure.
phase_3.both_description: The month of Toxcatl where the ending and beginning of the sun overlap.

steps.domain_action: Tezcatlipoca as the invisible source selects the potential vessel.
The youth is identified and marked with the divine insignia.
Transmission of the 'breath'—the youth is trained in flute and etiquette.
Chaining of temporal months into the ritual year sequence.
The ixiptla is wed to four wives, representing the cardinal diversity of the world.
The ixiptla exists as both ruler and victim, god and captive.
Separation from the wives at the lake shore, recovering singular focus.
The ascent of the pyramid; at each step a flute is broken and left behind.
Reaching the summit with the correct structural purity.
The stone knife completes the irreversible fixation of the year's energy.
The skin is flayed, transferring the divine mantle back to the priest/next cycle.
The cosmic year is sealed, ensuring the continuation of the sun.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Aztec Priesthood translating mythic structures into the Toxcatl calendar.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The sound of the clay flutes signaling the state of the divine-human coupling.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Tonalpohualli (count of days) and the collective witness of Tenochtitlan.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Xihpohualli (365-day solar cycle) determining the fixed time of the sacrifice.
phase_5.alfs_store: Tezcatlipoca's nature as 'Lord of the Near and Far'—the structural master key.

phase_6.cycle_cost: One human life and one solar year.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: An aging, entropic sun needing nourishment.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A renewed cosmic engine with stabilized winding.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The destruction of the individual vessel conserves the structural architecture of the state religion.
